_comment: The ONLY numbers and product claims allowed to appear in an ad. qa.py fails any stat that is not listed here or found verbatim in the segment evidence file. Everything marked NEEDS INPUT must be confirmed with the supplier/store before it can be used in copy.
_approved_numbers_note: Empty on purpose. Add a number here ONLY once it is substantiated, e.g. "30" for a 30-night trial once the store page states it. Until then qa.py warns on every figure, which is the correct default for a health-adjacent account.

candidate_facts_pending_confirmation.trial_length_nights: NEEDS INPUT - category norm is 30; product sheet recommends beating it
candidate_facts_pending_confirmation.warranty_years: NEEDS INPUT - product sheet recommends 2+ as the durability proof
candidate_facts_pending_confirmation.foam_density_kgm3: NEEDS INPUT - product sheet flags published density as THE durability proof point
candidate_facts_pending_confirmation.certifications: NEEDS INPUT - confirm CertiPUR / OEKO-TEX before any cert badge appears

safe_mechanism_language._note: Deploy the FELT mechanism, not the medical one. These phrasings describe what the night feels like and what the product physically is - neither asserts action on anatomy.
allowed: holds its shape all night instead of flattening by 2am
keeps its height from the first night to the hundredth
latex springs back instead of sinking through
open-cell latex lets heat move instead of trapping it
built to one height so your head stays where you put it
no stacking, no folding, no towel under the pillow
banned: treats or cures any named condition
any statement that the pillow acts on a bone, disc, nerve or muscle

safe_outcome_language._note: Felt experience only - what they notice, not what changed in their body.
allowed: wake up without the first-thing-in-the-morning stretch
the day's tightness stops following you to bed
sleep through instead of waking to reset the pillow
wake up feeling like you actually rested
